title: Feature Request: on Icons-Only Task Manager, Dolphin should show all Places by default
line: Right-clicking a running Dolphin in the task manager now lists all your Places instead of five and a "more Places…" entry.
explanation: Backend::placesActions() cut the Places list to five entries plus a "N more Places…" item whenever there were more than seven, and that item closed and reopened the context menu with the full list. Launchers (file manager pinned but not running) already got the full list, so the truncation only hit running file managers, making a Place three clicks away. The change removes the truncation and the now unused showAllPlaces parameter, signal and QML plumbing, so the menu always lists every visible Place; later groups (Remote, Recent, Devices) stay in their submenus as before.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: always show all Places in the context menu

A running file manager's context menu only listed five Places plus a "N
more Places…" entry that reopened the menu, which made reaching a Place
slower than opening the app. Show all of them, as launchers already do.

BUG: 440282
